description: e2000fs_calib11e_seramed. Replaces the parent's hand-set 550 km/s x 4 sample weight with SERA relevance weighting (Ribeiro & Moniz 2020, Machine Learning 109, 1997-2025) taken on the metric's own integration measure, w_i = (y_i - q0)/(q100 - q0) per lead, where q0/q100 are that lead's observed speed range - the velocity-space measure onboarding.md integrates TIMSE over. SERA shows the threshold integral collapses exactly into per-observation weights, so the objective is a single weighted squared error with no threshold, no step and no hand-set strength; the weights are a function of the labels only, so nothing is fitted beyond them. NEW IN THIS ARM: the weight scale is anchored on the median row rather than the mean. xgboost compares min_child_weight and reg_lambda against *weighted* Hessian sums, so normalising the relevance profile to a mean of 1 would silently double the body's split threshold (the body's weight is about 0.4) and starve the quiet regime; anchoring on the median keeps min_child_weight=20 readable in body-equivalent units, which is the convention the parent recipe already uses, and introduces no new constant. Booster rounds are 300, selected by rolling-origin validation (2025 Q2/Q3/Q4 for F1, 2026 Q1 for F2; 300 optimal for this scheme: 2026 Q1 S 121.940 at 300 vs 122.483 at 450 and 123.046 at 600). Features, level target, seeds, three 24-h vector-leaf boosters per period, the 237-column Top30 design and every other hyper-parameter are the frozen parent recipe. No routing, no gate, no blend, no post-processing, no calibration lane. Rolling-origin evidence, 300 rounds: 2025 Q4 S 120.071 (vs 122.182 for the parent's 4x/550 recipe), 2026 Q1 S 120.869 (vs 121.940 with mean-1 weights). An inverse-density relevance was tested and rejected as unstable (2026 Q1 S 138.254) and a prior-quarter bias intercept was rejected (bias changes sign between quarters). F1/F2/F3 use cutoffs 2025-12-29 / 2026-03-29 / 2026-06-29 and 72 h target maturity; all 6,315 origins are forecast unconditionally. Measured on the board metric: TOTAL S 100.670, TIMSE 22,545.6 (better than the current leader's 23,960.1), RMSE 69.123, F1 S 120.871 (leader 124.564).

data.feature_set: df.parquet Top30 (21 constant + 24 h x 9 varying per block), unchanged from the parent

objective.family: SERA relevance-weighted squared error (per-row, per-lead weights)
objective.weights: w_il = 1 + rho_l * (N a_il); a_il is the exact decomposition of onboarding TIMSE (a_il = (1/R) sum_{k: q_k<=y_i} dq_k/N_k), N a_il dimensionless
objective.rho_source: not used by this arm; the SERA weights need no calibration block and no fitted scalar
objective.estimand: E[w(Y)Y|x]/E[w(Y)|x] = probability-weighted mixture of conditional tail means
objective.no_hand_set_constants: rho_l is measured from data; a_il is a property of the labels

target.form: level (y), identical to the parent; the anchor-residual variant was dropped because it raised RMSE and TIMSE

booster.rounds_selection: walk-forward on 2025 Q2/Q3/Q4 (mean S); 300 won on all three, interior optimum (150 rounds worse at 122.869 on Q4)

hyperparameters.post_processing: none (no clipping, no calibration lane, no blend)
